remarks: Tucked behind mature hedges on a quiet cul-de-sac beautiful San Marino, this California ranch offers privacy, comfort, and effortless indoor-outdoor living within the highly regarded San Marino Unified School District. Warm hardwood floors, elegant architectural details, and abundant custom built-in cabinetry create inviting, functional living spaces. The spacious kitchen features a generous center island and is the true center of the home.
